info.name: Marvel Superheroes & Missions API
info.description: Comprehensive Postman collection for testing the Marvel Superheroes and Missions REST API built with Laravel 11, SQLite, and JWT under the Ponytail doctrine.

item.name: 01 - Authentication
item.description: Authentication endpoints for user registration, JWT login, profile fetching, and token invalidation.
